notes.title: Amarok Dreams Back In Production!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. I like to thank you all for the good support and feedbacks on "Amarok Dream". Me & the team have special news to tell you. "Amarok Dreams" will be back in production start of January. We don't know how long it will take us to update the project but me & the team will do our hardest to improve the game better then what you have played ;)

Again, Thank you all & see you soon!
- KirleyGames - Kyle Kirley
